issues.quote: Total assets stood at $624.9 million at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit. Amazon's total assets were about $624.9 billion, not million.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, but it has one error: total assets were $624.9 billion, not $624.9 million. These figures match what I know of Amazon's fiscal 2024 results: revenue of $638.0B, up 11% from $574.8B; net income of $59.2B; operating income of $68.6B; and cash and cash equivalents of about $78.8B.
